PerkinElmer Frontier and Spectrum Two FT-IR, NIR and FIR Spectroscopy Brochure
Product catalog summary
Introduction
PerkinElmer offers advanced IR spectroscopy solutions with the Frontier and Spectrum Two systems, designed for a wide range of applications from pharmaceuticals to environmental analysis.
Frontier IR System
The Frontier system is highly adaptable and configurable, providing superior performance for complex analyses. It features an upgradable optical system that covers a broad infrared range and allows for easy switching between ranges. The system supports a variety of specialized sampling accessories, making it suitable for diverse applications such as drug development and material analysis.
Spectrum Two IR System
Spectrum Two is designed for simplicity and portability, making it ideal for everyday analyses. It features a robust, compact design with wireless connectivity options, suitable for both laboratory and field use. The system includes OpticsGuard™ technology to protect against environmental effects and offers a user-friendly interface for ease of use.
Technological Innovations
PerkinElmer has a long history of innovation in IR technology, introducing several industry-firsts such as the first commercial IR microscope and the first FT-IR with smart accessory recognition. Their systems are designed to deliver fast, reliable results across various industries.
Conclusion
PerkinElmer's IR spectroscopy solutions are equipped to handle a wide range of analytical challenges, providing high-quality results for diverse applications.
